motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-bui.description: Build MotherDuck analytics into customer-facing applications with tenant isolation, backend routing, and serving APIs.
Build a MotherDuck dashboard as a Dive, choosing the analytical story, metrics, and section queries.
Build ingestion-to-serving pipelines on MotherDuck, including stage boundaries, transformations, and publication. Use for any recurring ingestion from an API, SaaS app, or database into MotherDuck.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-cli.description: Use the MotherDuck CLI for terminal queries, authentication, and file-based Dive or Flight workflows.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-con.description: Set up or troubleshoot MotherDuck connections, the MotherDuck MCP server in AI clients, authentication, client runtimes, and read scaling.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-cre.description: Create, edit, design, publish, share, or embed MotherDuck Dives, including responsive layout, light/dark themes, and buttons that write back through Flights.
Create, run, schedule, or debug MotherDuck Flights, Python jobs executed on MotherDuck compute.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-duc.description: Look up or repair DuckDB SQL syntax and verify MotherDuck-specific command and feature support.
Decide whether DuckLake fits a MotherDuck workload and operate it safely. Use whenever DuckLake, open table formats, or customer-owned buckets come up.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-ena.description: Roll out governed MotherDuck analytics to internal teams, choosing trusted datasets, access boundaries, and owners.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-exp.description: Find and understand MotherDuck databases, tables, columns, shares, and sample data, including which tables hold a given kind of data. Use first when a MotherDuck workspace or schema is unfamiliar.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-loa.description: Load files, object storage, dataframes, or external databases into MotherDuck with bulk ingestion. Use for any import of data into MotherDuck.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-man.description: Read or maintain MotherDuck Guides for business definitions, join rules, and reusable warehouse conventions.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-mig.description: Plan or implement migrations to MotherDuck with SQL translation, source-to-target validation, cutover, and rollback.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-mod.description: Design or implement MotherDuck analytical schemas and transformation models, including grain, types, and materialization.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-par.description: Standardize MotherDuck delivery for consultancies and agencies across client engagements with reusable provisioning, isolation, and handoff patterns.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-pri.description: Assess MotherDuck costs, plan fit, cost attribution, and ROI from the workload's compute and storage needs.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-que.description: Write, run, optimize, or troubleshoot DuckDB SQL against MotherDuck, including AI functions such as prompt_jev for in-SQL classification. Use for any SQL that targets MotherDuck, even simple queries, because MotherDuck has its own dialect and naming rules.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-res.description: Administer MotherDuck service accounts, tokens, Ducklings, and Dive embed sessions through the control-plane REST API.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-sec.description: Assess or configure MotherDuck access control: roles (RBAC), share grants, table-, row-, and column-level security, masking, tenant isolation, residency, and Terraform governance.

motherduckdb-agent-skills-motherduck-sha.description: Create, consume, or manage MotherDuck data shares, including audience grants, table filters, and refresh policy.
